feature_title: AI Assistant Credits & Paid Usage Consent

rationale.edition: both — the complete file list spans OSS-owned paths (web/src/components/**, web/src/composables/**, web/src/utils/**, src/api/management/src/request/ai/chat.rs, src/core/src/trial_quota.rs, src/infra/src/table/trial_quota_usage.rs, src/jobs/src/job/cloud.rs) AND enterprise-owned paths (web/src/enterprise/components/billings/**, web/src/enterprise/composables/router.ts, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/cloud/ai_credits.rs, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/cloud/billings/**). The billing / paid-AI-usage / credits / stripe keywords corroborate the enterprise layer; the OSS chat/credits/consent surface makes it a linked OSS+ENT pair.
rationale.skip: not skipped — the change is user-facing (new AI-credits notice, paid-usage consent, and billing UI, plus NL-query and incident-RCA gating). No explicit opt-out is present: feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty, and no tests-added label was passed.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted — the AI assistant now surfaces a low/exhausted credits notice with Plans / Contact-Sales / Refresh actions, and an exhausted org must grant paid-usage consent before further AI turns (chat, SQL NL generation, incident RCA). These are new, user-exercisable UI flows with clear data-test hooks.
rationale.area: GeneralTests — the AI assistant is a global, cross-cutting chat surface (web/src/components/O2AIChat.vue and web/src/components/ai-assistant/chat/**), not specific to Logs/Metrics/Traces, so no single product-area folder fits; the credits notice and consent dialog are the shared core to verify.
rationale.group: GeneralTests — no existing shard in the enterprise overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) or cloud matrix matches a global AI-assistant feature; the Engineer must verify/create the GeneralTests group in the OSS ci_matrix.json (this repo does not contain ci_matrix.json, only the enterprise/cloud overlays).
rationale.existing_tests: no E2E specs in the diff — changed_files.txt contains only Vitest unit specs (web/src/**/*.spec.ts) and no tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js, so there is no existing Playwright E2E coverage to enhance.
